1.title: Introduction to Python
1.explanation: Python is a programming language used to create software, websites, games, automation tools, and artificial intelligence applications.
1.practice: Write a program that prints your name.
1.quiz: Which function displays text in Python?

2.title: Python Comments
2.explanation: Comments are notes in code that Python ignores. They help programmers understand programs.
2.code:
# This is a comment
print("Learning Python")
2.practice: Add a comment to your program.

3.title: Variables
3.explanation: Variables store information that can be used later in a program.

4.title: Data Types
4.explanation: Python has different data types such as strings, integers, floats, and booleans.
4.practice: Create variables with different data types.

5.title: Input Function
5.explanation: The input function allows users to enter information into a program.
5.practice: Ask the user for their favorite color.

7.title: Strings
7.explanation: Strings are text values stored inside quotes.

8.title: String Methods
8.explanation: String methods change or analyze text.

9.title: Lists
9.explanation: Lists store multiple values in one variable.
9.practice: Create a list of three items.

10.title: If Statements
10.explanation: If statements allow programs to make decisions.

11.title: Else Statements
11.explanation: Else runs when an if condition is false.
11.quiz: What runs when if is false?

12.title: Elif Statements
12.explanation: Elif allows multiple conditions in one decision.

13.title: For Loops
13.explanation: For loops repeat code for each item in a sequence.
13.practice: Create a loop that prints numbers.
13.quiz: Which keyword creates a for loop?

14.title: While Loops
14.explanation: While loops repeat while a condition is true.
14.quiz: When does a while loop stop?

15.title: Break and Continue
15.explanation: Break stops a loop and continue skips to the next loop step.

16.title: Functions
16.explanation: Functions are reusable blocks of code.

17.title: Function Parameters
17.explanation: Parameters allow functions to receive information.
17.practice: Create a function with a parameter.

18.title: Return Values
18.explanation: Return sends a result back from a function.
18.practice: Create a function that returns a value.

21.title: Error Handling
21.explanation: Error handling prevents programs from crashing by managing unexpected problems.
21.practice: Create a program using try and except.

22.title: File Reading
22.explanation: Python can open and read information stored in files.
22.practice: Create a text file and read it.

23.title: File Writing
23.explanation: Python can save information by writing to files.

24.title: Classes
24.explanation: Classes are blueprints for creating objects.

25.title: Objects
25.explanation: Objects are created from classes and contain data and actions.
25.practice: Create an object from a class.

26.title: Constructors
26.explanation: Constructors initialize object data when created.
26.practice: Create a class with a constructor.

27.title: Inheritance
27.explanation: Inheritance allows one class to receive features from another class.
27.quiz: What allows classes to share features?

28.title: Polymorphism
28.explanation: Polymorphism allows the same action to work in different ways.
28.practice: Use the same function with different data.

29.title: Python Libraries
29.explanation: Libraries provide ready-made tools for programmers.

30.title: Installing Packages
30.explanation: Packages can be installed to add new Python features.

31.title: Virtual Environments
31.explanation: Virtual environments create separate spaces for Python projects and their packages.
31.practice: Create a virtual environment for a project.

32.title: Lambda Functions
32.explanation: Lambda functions are small anonymous functions written in one line.
32.quiz: What are small one-line functions called?

33.title: Map Function
33.explanation: Map applies a function to every item in a list.

34.title: Filter Function
34.explanation: Filter selects items that match a condition.

35.title: List Comprehensions
35.explanation: List comprehensions create lists using short syntax.
35.code:
numbers = [x for x in range(5)]
print(numbers)

36.title: JSON Data
36.explanation: JSON stores structured information that programs can read and write.

37.title: APIs
37.explanation: APIs allow programs to communicate with other services.

38.title: Regular Expressions
38.explanation: Regular expressions search and process patterns in text.

39.title: Testing Python Code
39.explanation: Testing checks whether programs work correctly.

40.title: Debugging Tools
40.explanation: Debugging tools help find and fix problems in programs.

41.title: Python Databases
41.explanation: Python can connect to databases to store and retrieve information.

42.explanation: Tables store organized data inside databases.

43.explanation: Python can create websites using frameworks like Flask and Django.

from flask import Flask
app = Flask(__name__)

44.explanation: Python can automate repeated computer tasks.

45.title: Working with Dates
45.explanation: Python can handle dates and times.

46.explanation: Threads allow programs to perform multiple tasks.

47.explanation: Machine learning allows computers to learn from data.

48.explanation: AI allows computers to perform tasks that normally require intelligence.
